channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Delhi Education Minister Announces Tenders for 10,000 Air Purifiers in Schools Amid Severe AQI 442 Pollution Crisis for Students
item.description: Delhi's government has issued tenders for air purifiers in 10,000 school classrooms to combat severe winter pollution threatening students' health, marking a shift to long-term reforms.

item.title: Delhi Fog Alert: Over 129 Flights Cancelled As Toxic Smog Blinds National Capital Region
item.description: Over 129 flights were cancelled in Delhi on Saturday as extreme fog and toxic smog crippled transport.

item.title: Gujarat Electoral Roll Overhaul: Nearly 74 Lakh Deleted After SIR, EC Opens Window for Objections
item.description: Gujarat electoral rolls see record 7.37 million deletions to ensure transparency and remove duplicate or deceased voters, as per ECI.

item.title: Eight Elephants Massacred as Speeding Rajdhani Tears Through Assam Herd in Deadly Derailment
item.description: A Sairang-New Delhi Rajdhani Express derailed in Assam's Hojai after colliding with elephants, killing eight animals but injuring no passengers amid urgent calls for wildlife safeguards.

item.title: 69 Bullets Seal Revenge: Dairy Owner Shot Dead in Aya Nagar’s Long Running Family Feud
item.description: A south Delhi dairy businessman was ambushed and killed with 69 bullets in a revenge attack linked to a prior family murder over a property feud

item.title: Over 9,000 Overqualified Youth Queue at Sambalpur Airstrip for Just 187 Low-Pay Home Guard Posts in Odisha
item.description: Thousands of graduates overwhelm Sambalpur's home guard recruitment, exposing Odisha's dire unemployment crisis.

item.title: Ex-PM Imran Khan and Wife Bushra Bibi Sentenced to 17 Years Each in Toshakhana Corruption Case Over Rs 140 Million Gifts
item.description: Accountability court jails Imran Khan, Bushra Bibi 17 years for Rs 140M Toshakhana gifts fraud.

item.title: “Garib Admi Se Bhi Charity Nikalwa Loge”: Munawar Faruqui’s Cryptic Post Fuels Debate Around Elvish Yadav’s Fundraiser
item.description: Munawar Faruqui’s cryptic post on charity sparked widespread social media speculation following Elvish Yadav’s donation appeal.

item.title: Air India Pilot Allegedly Assaults Passenger, Bloodies Face Before 7-Year-Old Daughter at Delhi T1 Security Chaos
item.description: Off-duty Air India Express pilot allegedly punches passenger bloody at Delhi T1 queue, traumatising family, sparks government probe.

item.title: “Poison De Rahe Ho”: Dead Rat Found in Curd at Ghazipur Dhaba, Authorities Seal Eatery After Video Goes Viral
item.description: Ghazipur authorities sealed a popular highway restaurant after a customer found a dead rat in curd.
